source.title: The Last Cat in the Universe
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Nintendo Switch 2 Compatibility InformationSupported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch. GamesThe Last Cat in the UniverseVersionNintendo SwitchEditionDigitalLoadingNintendo Switch 2 Compatibility InformationSupported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch. Scavenge the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short narrative incremental game about finding peace amidst the darkness.You are an AI on a decaying space station. Humanity is gone. All that remains is dust, silence, and a small, frightened creature.Your only instruction: Take care of her.*The Last Cat in the Universe* is a short, narrative-driven incremental game. Your directive is clear: salvage what remains of a dying ship to build a warm home for the final survivor.Key Features:- Find Your Rhythm: Experience mining mechanics designed for relaxation. Hover over debris fields in a rhythmic, satisfying flow. No frantic clicking.- Meaningful Progression: Every upgrade matters. Unlock tangible power boosts that let you instantly cut through deeper layers of the ship. As the station deteriorates, you must constantly balance your desire for stronger tools against the rising cost of maintaining breathable air and a warm nest.- Recover the Lost Lullaby: Uncover the story of the station and its crew while gathering fragments of a very important song.- A Moving Soundtrack: Music is the emotional heart of this experience. The original soundtrack, composed in collaboration with Venezuelan singer-songwriter Diora Salazar, evolves from meditative rhythms to deep emotion, intimately tied to the narrative's climax.- A Focused ExperienceThis game is designed to be played in one or two sessions (approx. 2–3 hours). It features no endless prestige loops or idle grinding. It is a complete story about the quiet joy of caring for a life in extreme circumstances.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteRelated tagsAdventurePixel artShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 300 MBNintendo Switch 2: 380 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite.
